work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXIII appoints Giuseppe Maria d’Alessandria minister general of the Friars Minor (Spain excepted) with the procurators and definitors for six years; LF36971 → LF36977 across the garbled page number aalayne LF36974; LF37038 → LF37044 across own provenance LF37040 and page number 252 LF37043; LF37105 → LF37109 across running title LF37108; complete 13 March 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36949–36949; the source closing at LF37116–37119 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia martii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
